name: yolov8n_cat_emotion_v8_sota
architecture_note: YOLOv8n SOTA with calibrated QAT (not v9), optimized for Arm Ethos-U55 NPU

qat_and_calibration_innovations.true_background_margin_loss: Margin-based background suppression preventing false alarms on textures and non-cat objects
qat_and_calibration_innovations.hard_negative_dataset_augmentation: Hard negative background images integrated into training
qat_and_calibration_innovations.bounding_box_tightening: Strong localization loss preventing duplicate / oversized bounding boxes
qat_and_calibration_innovations.unmodified_firmware_compatibility: Preserves standard dual-tensor signature and flash offset 0x00B7B000 (100% compatible with Himax output.img)
